standard_prerequisites.name: Colimit criterion for ind-smooth maps
standard_prerequisites.use: Frames the claim as factoring every finitely presented A -> Lambda through a smooth algebra.

core_obligations: By induction on a nilpotency exponent n it suffices to treat I^2 = 0.
Given a finitely presented A -> Lambda, the lift-once lemma gives A -> B/J -> Lambda with B smooth over R and J finitely generated inside IB.
The lift-twice lemma gives B -> B' -> Lambda with B' smooth and the composite killing J, so B -> B' factors through A.
Composing gives the wanted factorization A -> B' -> Lambda with B' smooth; the when-colimit lemma finishes.
